cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 62 (Tuscaloosa) since November 2022. University of Alabama graduate. Worked 39 years as chief financial officer of Tuscaloosa County, retiring in 2021.
cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace, where he grew up, or when he moved to Alabama. We found no stated positions or documented actions from him on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. The pages we had did not show the bills he sponsored.

qual.background: Served as chief financial officer of Tuscaloosa County for 39 years until 2021, then won the District 62 House seat in 2022 and was re-elected in 2026.
qual.why: Years of county government budget work and prior service in the Alabama House fit a job of writing law and the state budget.
